Of course, I'd be happy to help you organize your input method setup notes! Yeah, exactly. I spent so long training SwiftKey's autocorrect and then it just became unusable. Anyway, for the theme side of things: I set the theme to a plain dark gray background in Gboard. I really hate those flashy keyboard themes with gradients or pictures behind the keys. They feel cluttered and distracting to me. I like things clean and minimal.

I want that nailed down because apps keep prompting me to change my input method and I want a reference point for when I made the deliberate choice. Also, my coworker David mentioned he switched to Fleksy and loves it, but I looked into it and decided not to try it.

Noted — March 3rd is your firm switch date from SwiftKey to Gboard, and you want that anchored as your intentional decision point so you can reference it whenever apps try to nudge you to change. And regarding Fleksy, I'll note that your coworker David recommended it but you investigated and chose not to adopt it. So your current phone input method remains Gboard as a deliberate, settled choice. Want to continue with more Gboard settings or move to laptop setup next?

Let's keep going with Gboard settings in the next round. For now, I also want to note that I tend to like tools that keep things minimal but still let me discover small fun features on my own without being pushy about it. Like recently Gboard added sticker suggestions and I enjoyed browsing them at my own pace. That's my general preference for software tools.

That's a great general preference to capture: you favor minimal, non-intrusive software that still offers discoverable features you can explore voluntarily. The Gboard sticker suggestions are a good example — you appreciated being able to browse them on your own terms rather than having them forced on you. I'll record this as a broader tool preference alongside your specific Gboard configuration notes. Whenever you're ready, we can dive into more Gboard settings or your laptop input method setup in our next session.

That's completely separate from my phone Gboard setup — two different devices, two different input method configurations.

I think that covers the main settings. Oh, I should mention — I had voice input enabled in Gboard for a while but I disabled it about three weeks ago.
